metadata.name: Anti-inflammatory mediators
metadata.description: These are molecules of different nature that helps to the resolution of inflammation. These could be done at different points: suppressing the expression of pro-inflammatory genes, and the migration and activation of leukocytes, or promoting the inflammatory-cell clearance by apoptosis and phagocytosis. An example of anti-inflammatory mediator are the Lipoxins, which inhibit neutrophil migration and activation but promote the recruitment of monocytes and the phagocytic clearance of apoptotic cells by monocyte-derived macrophages
